releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.61 — the chat list. (1) Every row now reads as two clean lines on one grid: the name and the clock share the first line, and everything about the message sits on the second — delivery tick, message-type icon, who spoke, what they said, pin, mute and the unread count. Before, the clock and the badge were on different lines with a spacer between them, so nothing lined up as you scrolled; that is what made the list look unstructured. (2) In groups you can now tell who is talking at a glance: the sender's name is drawn in the app's colour, set apart from the message text, instead of being blended into one long grey sentence. Your own messages read 'You:' in a quieter grey. (3) Rows slide into place when a chat is pinned, archived or pushed down by a new message, instead of jumping. (4) Unread chat names are now semibold, and the clock is bold and tinted when there is something new.
